claim: On the engine thread doubles behave as 24-bit floats after device creation (D3D9 without D3DCREATE_FPU_PRESERVE): the perf recorder's frame deltas, formed from an absolute QPC time in ms (~1e8), came out as 0, 8 and 16 ms (p50 0.0 over 6354 frames). Taking the delta in integer ticks first (devcore.h PerfDeltaMs) gives p50 1.868, p99 3.464 ms on land_small at 1920x1080 (RTX 4090)
